title: Dynamics of states of infinite quantum systems as a cornerstone of the second law of thermodynamics
summary: We improve on our version of the second law of thermodynamics as a deterministic theorem for quantum spin systems in two basic aspects. The first concerns the general statement of the second law: spontaneous changes in an adiabatically closed system will always be in the direction of increasing mean entropy, which rises to a maximal value.
